title: Signing Speed of a Ridgeline Installation Services Change Order
content:
How quickly the customer signs a change order on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract sets the signing-speed share of the change order administration fee.

**Clause.** Signing-speed share of the change order administration fee: the signing gap is the calendar days from the date part of the change order request's registration to the date the change order was billed; a signing gap of 0 days takes the same-day signing share of 0.8, a signing gap equal to the program's change order signing days takes the last-day signing multiple of 1.2, and any other signing gap takes a signing-speed share of 1.

The change order administration fee is multiplied by the signing-speed share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the change order administration fee is rounded, the change order administration fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Terms used

- **The change order request** is the most recent change order request on the contract; the date that counts is the calendar date on which it was registered.
- **The date the change order was billed** is the date of the most recent change order billing line on the contract.

## Change order signing days by program

| Program | Change order signing days | Gap taking 0.8 | Gap taking 1.2 | Other gaps |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 3 | 0 | 3 | 1 or 2 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 3 | 0 | 3 | 1 or 2 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 5 | 0 | 5 | 1 to 4 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 5 | 0 | 5 | 1 to 4 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 5 | 0 | 5 | 1 to 4 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 5 | 0 | 5 | 1 to 4 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical fee of 50.00 before the share, 5-day program, request registered 4 October 15:20)

| Change order billed | Signing gap | Share | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 October | 0 | 0.8 | 40.00 |
| 6 October | 2 | 1 | 50.00 |
| 9 October | 5 | 1.2 | 60.00 |
